activities.name: Copy data from ADLSG2
activities.description: This activity will establish the connectivity and copy the files from Source to destination

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT '@{pipeline().Pipeline}' as pipeline_name,'@{pipeline().RunId}' as pipeline_id,'Running' as run_status,@{pipeline().parameters.parent_job_id} as parent_job_id,@{pipeline().parameters.child_job_id} as child_job_id,'' as source,'' as target,'@{pipeline().TriggerTime}' as run_start_ts,0 as src_count,0 as tgt_count,'' as recon_status,'' as error_code,'' as error_description

text.value:
UPDATE eds_job_run
SET run_status = '@{activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.executionDetails[0].status}',
    run_end_ts = GETDATE(),
    src_count = @{activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.dataRead},
    tgt_count = @{activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.dataWritten},
    error_code = '@{activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.errors[0].Code}',
    error_description = '@{replace(activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.errors[0].Message,'''','')}',
    loaddt = @{variables('loaddt')},
    recon_status = '@{activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.executionDetails[0].status}'
WHERE parent_job_id = @{pipeline().parameters.parent_job_id}
  AND child_job_id = @{pipeline().parameters.child_job_id}
AND pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'

expression.value: @equals(activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.dataRead, activity('Copy data from ADLSG2').output.dataWritten)

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT param_name, param_value 
FROM eds_job_param 
WHERE parent_job_id = @{pipeline().parameters.parent_job_id}
  AND child_job_id = @{pipeline().parameters.child_job_id}
  AND is_encrpt = 'N'
  AND param_env = '@{pipeline().parameters.param_env}'
ORDER BY param_id
